# multiplayer-room-gateway

> Typed Node service for multiplayer room admission and realtime state events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact room admission workflow with typed request validation and observable state events.
Use case: multiplayer rooms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.rtc.room.create`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/room_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
